create_temporal_model: create a TemporalModel for 3D pose estimation with temporal convolutions and configurable filter widths
build_temporal_model_optimized: build a TemporalModelOptimized1f model optimized for single-frame batching with strided convolutions
test_receptive_field: test the receptive_field method to compute the total receptive field in frames for a temporal model
test_total_causal_shift: test the total_causal_shift method to compute the asymmetric padding offset for causal convolutions
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a temporal model with input shape (batch, frames, joints, features) to get 3D pose output
